title: These Git Repositories Changed How I Manage My Home Lab
summary: This article describes six Git repository types the author recommends every serious home lab operator maintain, drawn from personal experience rebuilding and managing [[proxmox|Proxmox]], Docker, and [[kubernetes|Kubernetes]] environments. It is aimed at home lab enthusiasts who want to adopt GitOps and infrastructure-as-code practices. The article covers repository structure, what to store in each, and what should never be committed to Git.
